summary: Validate a fund's declared benchmark before comparing it with an index, mark missing benchmarks, match live quote names and constituent slugs, report failed constituent fetches, and describe tracking as an expense-ratio ranking.
reason: A mismatched fund and index could be displayed as related, alternate quote spellings could fetch the wrong constituent CSV, missing benchmark or constituent data was unclear, and some command descriptions claimed NAV fidelity that the CLI does not calculate. The generated root help and which index must stay aligned with the corrected novel feature descriptions on reprint.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover equivalent and mismatched benchmarks, exact quote preference, canonical quote to constituent slug mapping, labeled constituent failures, and expense-ratio ordering with undisclosed costs last.
